balls.text: on a length and outside off, NCN bends his knees and swings it towards long-off. Pollard runs in from there and attacks the ball, he flings an accurate throw to the keepers' but NCN is in
right in the blockhole on and around off, squirted to mid-off
low full toss outside off, pushed to long-off
near yorker, squeezed to backward point
on a length and outside off, he shuffles across and lap-scoops it over short fine leg. Dinky stuff
yorker outside off, jabbed back to the bowler

Simmons pulls off a stunner! He takes flight. Malinga has his man now. Its a legal ball. Back of a length and outside off, Yuvraj carves it in the air off the back foot. Simmons flies to his right at backward point and completes a ripper of a catch; one-handed too. Simmons is mobbed by his team-mates. Jonty Rhodes applauds from the Mumbai dug out

Caught behind the wicket? Malinga and Parthiv appear confident. Yuvraj turns his back. Did that carry to the keeper. Nope, it bounced. On a length and moving away outside off, he takes a couple of paces forward and seeks to drive. Runs it off the face of the bat to Parthiv, who dives across to his left, but the ball bounces before he had collected it
another slower offering outside off at 118ks, he slogs early and misses. They sneak in a bye though
slower cutter outside off, Tiwary swings and misses. Undone by the change of pace
Tiwary gets into the act. Malinga errs in length, delivers a full toss, which is drilled fiercely down the ground. Long-off is beaten
slower back of a length ball on middle, dabbed gently behind point
Yuvraj makes room, the bowler follows him. Squirted to leg for only a single
fifty for Yuvraj. He blows a kiss and celebrates. That's a humongous hit. Full on the leg stump, whipped away with the wrists over backward square leg
nonchalance from Yuvraj. Shortish and on the leg stump, flicked away in the to the right of deep fine leg. Goes all the way
MM grunts as e delivers another near yorker, picked away through midwicket
Yuvraj steps away outside leg, MM chases him. Yuvraj is cramped for room as he squeezes it behind square leg off the inner part of the bat
yorker on the leg stump, off the pad and rolls to the right of Parthiv
Tiwary steps down the track, nearly yorks himself and squeezes it past midwicket
whipped away to long-on
whoa! I-m-p-e-r-i-o-u-s. Half-volley outside off, he punches it on the up and sends it over the covers. Sweeper slides in the deep but his effort is futile. Yuvraj has the hat-trick...
Malinga delivers a yorker outside off, Yuvraj backs away, reaches out and inside-edges it. A leaping Parthiv is beaten
Malinga seeks another yorker, Yuvraj takes a couple of paces forward, converts it into a full toss and whips it from outside off over midwicket
right in the blockhole on off, dug out in front of the covers
Yuvraj hits one, finally. Fuller and outside off, scythed over backward point. Away she skims to the boundary
back of a length and slanting across, Yuvraj wants to mow it over leg but can't connect

Mathews holes out. On a length and outside off, Mathews hunts for an encore. He does not get hold of it, slicing it straight down the gullet (not literally) of Suchith at long-off. Maiden wicket for Pandya in the IPL and he is mobbed by his team-mates. Suchith makes no mistake here
superb connection from Mathews. Length on off, right in the slot, Mathews swings it over deep midwicket
good length and outside off, sticks in the pitch and stops on Yuvraj. Steered past the covers
swing a miss to a back-of-a-length ball slanting away outside off. You are right, Suresh Kumar
mighty full and swerves in on middle and leg. Not quite a yorker, whipped to deep midwicket
on a length and outside off, whirl of the wrists as Mathews flicks it towards cow corner
right in the blockhole on middle, Yuvraj squirts it in front of point with an angled bat
fractionally short and outside off, poked in front of the covers for another of those scampered singles
good length and outside off, steered through cover-point
shortish and on off, Yuvraj checks his cut and drops it in front of the covers
back of a length and angled across, chopped to deep third man
pitched up and angling outside off, Yuvraj chases it with a flashy drive. Beaten again.... Strike three
back of a length and slanting away outside off, Yuvraj camps back, seeks to cut but can't connect. Beaten again
on a length and curling away outside off, Yuvraj pushes away from the body and is beaten

Mathews runs down the track, Pandya drags his length back. Punched to mid-off for a speedy single, Harbhajan misses the attempted direct hit. Mathews would have made his ground even if Harbhajan has nailed the stumps down
fuller length and outside off, he tips forward and blocks it to the covers
clipped away off the pads in front of square on the leg side
good length on off, patted to the covers
full on middle and leg, whipped to long-on
drifting outside leg, poor ball. Yuvraj duly helps it along the way, fine on the leg side with a pull. Harbhajan chases in vain
looped up on off, chipped over a ducking Yuvraj for one
length and outside off, Yuvraj swats it to long-on. Pollard runs across to his left from long-on and cuts it off
flighted on off, pressed in front of the covers. End of a brilliant spell from Harbhajan: 4-1-11-2
flat and fired on middle and leg, dug out to the right of the bowler. Diving save
tossed up on middle, Yuvraj answers with a dead bat
short and outside off, punched down to long-on
Harbhajan befuddles Jadhav. The batsman chips down the track, Harbhajan pushes a slider outside off. Jadhav can't connect with the cut, Parthiv whips the bails off
looped up on off, laced to long-off
flighted and around off, forward and pushed back to Suchith
full and outside off, he waits it and employs the latest of dabs. Nearly picks it off the keeper's gloves and runs it through vacant slip cordon
low full toss on off, knocked to mid-on
width on offer outside off, chopped to point
arm-ball, arrows in, kept out via an inside edge
full and on the stumps, Jadhav sinks to one knee, pasting a slog-sweep over midwicket
back of a length outside off and turning away, punched behind point for a couple
slid through quicker, Yuvraj misses the defensive push and takes it on the pad. But this was snaking down leg
tossed up nicely, slower through the air with extra bounce, Yuvi aims to slog sweep, the ball loops off the arm to slip. No glove on that
quicker and outside off, cracked to point off the back foot
looped up outside off, turning away. Yuvi looks to drive and squirts it to point
full and flat on off, milked down to long-on
another short ball, another four. This wasn't convincing from Yuvraj. Dragged short and outside off, Yuvraj mishits the pull, beats mid-on's dive to his right
dug in short and outside off, he camps back and pulls it firmly to the deep-midwicket boundary
pitched further up and outside off, Yuvraj drives on the rise and finds covers
fuller on middle, slowy on off, Yuvraj waits on it and dabs it behind point. He looks for a single but decides against it
slung mighty full and outside off, bunted to the covers
very full and on off, blocked to leg with no feet movement

tossed up and outside off, Jadhav aims to sweep it away. Skews it over Malinga at short fine leg off a top edge. Malinga, chases and slides. But he had hurt himself in the process, jamming his knee onto the turf
pitched up and outside off, Yuvraj eases forward and drives it to deep cover
straight roller on off, Yuvraj defends gingerly
looped up and spinning away, ignored
Jadhav goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps it to deep square leg
down the track, Harbhajan drags his length back. Quietly worked to midwicket
fuller and straighter, picked away through midwicket
driven down to long-on and Yuvraj is off the mark

good riposte from Suchith after being hit for a four first ball, sharp return catch. Duminy's knock has been cut short. This was pushed through flatter, Duminy looks to punch it away but ends up chipping it to the left of Suchith. The bowler moves across, takes it and tumbles onto the ground
back of a length and outside off, punched to the left of the covers. The fielder's dive proves futile
quicker and outside off, flat-batted to long-off. Vinay fumbles a bit, but only a single results
hello Suchith, says Duminy. Down the track and whipped powerfully over midwicket
fuller and outside off, Jadhav inches forward to defend it
veering onto the pads at 94ks, Duminy misses the glance but they cross over for a leg bye
forward and pressed to the covers
slides on with the arm, Duminy gets an inside edge onto the pad
slid through outside off, chopped to the covers

Bhajji takes a leaf from Malinga's playbook and takes a wicket of his first ball. Vinay pouches the leading edge at short third man. Pandya and Suchith would heave a sigh of relief. The slog goes all wrong for Iyer, Bhajji held this one back. Popped to Vinay
length ball on middle, Duminy offers a straight bat and lofts it over the bowler's head. No chance for mid-on and mid-off
fullish and on the leg stump, he picks it up from there and whips it over midwicket. Very, very wristy
pitched up and outside off, driven into the covers. The fielder fails to effect a direct hit and Iyer is in. Bhajji backs up Simmons' throw
punched to mid-off and they take an extra run off an overthrow
good length and outside off, pushed to point
back of a length and on middle, guided to third man
length on off, Iyer sizes it up, frees his arms and smites it over mid-on. He knew that the fielder was inside the ring and exploited it to his advantage
good length and shaping away, he fiddles with it and is beaten

Pandya and Suchith almost collide and drop Iyer. Iyer attacks this ball and slices this one over cover-point again. The two fielders run back, fail to make a call, and shell Iyer. Pandya got to the ball, juggled and put it down. He was perhaps distracted by an approaching Suchith. The bowler is not pleased with the effort and sinks to his knees. Suchith can't grab it on the rebound either
back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers
fuller and outside off, Iyer swings his arms and slices it over cover-point, one-bounce four. And Iyer gets to 300 runs in his maiden IPL
not middled, no problem. Shortish on middle, Iyer backs away, swipes and drags it through midwicket off a thick inside edge. The quick outfield comes to the fore
shot! Length on middle, Duminy runs down the track and hoists it over long-on. That hit had class written all over it. Straight bat directing the operations
back of a length and outside off, mistimed punch in front of cover-point. There is a brief communication breakdown in the middle but no harm done for DD
good length, tight line on off, he yanks one hand off the bat as he pushes it unconvincingly to the covers
good length on off accompanied some by some movement, poked out in front of point
Vinay sustains the inward shape, flicked through midwicket off the inner part of the bat

good length, tailing in. Duminy prods forward and manages an inside edge in front of square leg. Duminy aims for a speedy single, but Vinay rushes in, dives and collects the ball, forcing Duminy to retreat
beauty from MM! Back of a length and zipping away with some extra bounce. Iyer spars at it and is beaten soundly
bumper angled across off, whizzes off the surface. Iyer yanks his head out of the way. Parthiv leaps to collect the ball, but wide called by the umpire
pitched up and angling away outside off, driven to point, can't thread the gap again
pitched up and outside off, he drives crisply but finds the covers
short and on off, with some extra lift, Iyer hangs and fends it onto the pitch
good length ball coming in, pushed down the ground for a quick single
back of a length and angling away outside off, guided to deep third man via soft hands
back of a length and sort of hurries just a shade outside off, Duminy goes hard on the cut and ends up chopping it on the ground in front of point
on a length and swerves back in to catch Duminy on the pads. He did not meet with the flick, but this was snaking down leg
Malinga tests Duminy with a short ball, he swivels on the back foot and pulls it over backward square leg
another full toss outside off, Duminy misses out again, finds the man at the covers
low full toss outside off as Malinga does not nail the yorker. Pushed to the covers

Malinga strikes first ball, Agarwal has nicked off for a golden duck! Teaser from Malinga - pitched up and nibbling away outside off, Agarwal has a wishy-washy poke at it away from the body and offers a dolly catch to Parthiv off an outer edge
Fourth win on the trot for Mumbai Indians.They continue their surge and jump to No.4. Shortish googly, spins in, dabbed behind point with soft hands after backing away
Pollard has nailed this! Absolutely nailed this. Pushed through on the leg stump, swung flat and hard over long-on. Beats Coulter-Nile in the deep
length on middle, nips down the track and swipes to deep midwickey
length on the leg stump as Pollard makes some room and swats it wide of deep square leg. They push for two and get it. Coulter-Nile vents his frustration out and smashes the stumps at his end
fullish and on off, he backs away and carves it in the air, the lands lands in front of sweeper cover
shot! Pitched up and width on offer as well. Rayudu takes full of it as he deliberately slices it through backward point
might full, drilled ram-rod straight, so much so hit the stumps at the non-strikers'. NCN did not deflect it away. They hustle across for one
yorker outside off, Pollard can't squirt it out after making some room
And that's cricket's equivalent of the Hulk smash. Length on the stumps, slowy in pace, Pollard sends it into the orbit over deep midwicket

Mathews misses the yorker, dishes out a full toss outside off, Rayudu makes room and wants to smite it through the covers. Gets a thick outside edge to the right of a diving Jadhav. Rayudu fetches the desired result, though
full and outside off, flat-batted thump to long-off
short and hurries on off at 140.9ks, pushed back to the bowler. Too quick for Pollard
bumper from Mathews, boings over to the keeper after beating Pollard on the hook. Jadhav appeals for a catch behind the wicket, Mathews joins, not given. No nick, no glove either
length on middle, Rayudu runs down the track again and drills it fiercely back at Mathews, who deflects it to long-off off the ankle. Just a single
length from Mathews, Rayudu races down the track and goes over mid-off, four off the first ball
length on middle, Rayudu makes room and flays it to long-off
another full toss outside off, punched to the right of long-off
full toss on the leg stump, he clears his front leg and hoicks it over to deep midwicket with a cross bat
very full and on off, driven down to long-off for one
fired full on off, pushed to the covers for a speedy one
clears long-on. Length outside off, Rayudu swings hard, giving it marching orders over long-on. Impressive strike
back of a length, wrong'un. Punched down to long-on off the back foot
pushed through outside off, dabbed with soft hands towards short third man
nifty footwork from Jadhav. Drifting down leg, Jadhav kicks it to short leg
darted down leg, wide called
and Pollard plunges into the thick of things. Fuller and outside off, he flexes his muscles and annihilates a six over long-on
flighted and full, another googly. Pollard does not read it, comes down the track and pads it away

played on! Undone by the googly and the Wankhede has been hushed into silence. This one spins in from outside off with extra bounce, Rohit backs away and seeks to cut it through the covers, perhaps. But drags it back onto the stumps
pitched up and outside off, drilled to deep cover
low full toss on off, swiped away to the right of long-on. Tahir was shy of putting in a dive in the deep
waist-high full toss, Rayudu takes a step forward and clubs it down to long-on, though without power. Rayudu looks expectantly at the umpire, not given a no ball and he shakes his head
full on off, Rohit wants to drill it down the ground, has to settle with an inside edge onto the pad. The ball wanders away in front of the covers
a wild swing and a miss to a back of a length offering outside off
back of a length and outside off, Rayudu takes the aerial route and lofts it over vacant mid-on. There is protection in the deep
good length and outside off, hacked to long-on
on the fuller side and outside off, Rohit makes room and thrashes a drive past the covers
Rayudu skips out and whips this back-of-a-length ball through midwicket
wrong'un, spins in, down the track but he does not meet the pitch of the ball. Squirt-edges it in front of long-on. Mishra runs across and behind to hunt the ball down
looped up on middle, driven inside-out through the covers
Rayudu stays back and punches it to long-on
shortish googly, I reckon, down the track and gets an inside edge back to Mishra
back of a length and outside off, glided to deep third man with soft hands
full toss outside off, smashed down the ground, beat's mid-off dive to his right. The bowler had no chance as well
drifting onto the pads, misses the glance. Dribbles to the left of the keeper off the pad
fullish and angled in on off, pushed to the left of the bowler
banged in shortish and outside off, Rayudu gets on top of the bounce and dabs it to third man
on a length and outside off, Rohit comes forward and slices it to point, where Yuvraj dives to his left and stops the ball. He was hit on the wrist there and grimaces in pain
looked like a googly, chopped hard into the ground in front of the covers

precise placement. Whipped away to cow corner, bisecting long-on and deep midwicket. NCN dives to his right from long-on and aims to swat the ball in, but it rolls away to the boundary. Tiwary was running across from deep midwicket
sprays this one down leg, the keeper dives to his left and is beaten. Zaheer mops it up in the deep
slid through outside off and turns away on a back of a length, punched towards sweeper cover
pitched up and outside off, laced to deep cover
pushed to long-off
low full toss on leg, whipped to deep midwicket
on a length and outside off, driven to point, where Yuvraj flings to his left and makes a diving save
on a length and outside off, Rayudu goes for a booming on-the-rise drive, gets a thick outside edge that runs away to third man
length on off, Rohit taps it down to long-on for a comfortable single
back of a length and sliding across, he cuts loosely and gets beaten
back of a length and outside off, Rayudu stays back and cuts it to third man
good length on the fourth-stump line, Rayudu camps back and defends it back to the bowler
picked away off the pads behind square on the leg side
skiddy ball on middle, he makes a bit of room and slaps it to deep cover
flat and quick outside off, slapped to point
slid through on middle, Rayudu hangs on the back foot and nurdles a single through square leg
straight on middle, bunted to long-on
looped up nicely, he nearly lobs it back to the bowler
veering onto the pads, soft leading edge in front of Tahir as Rayudu does not get hold of the flick
tossed up on middle, worked to leg
flat on the leg stump, whippily driven to long-on
pitched up and outside off, driven to the covers
clean and effective. Full and on middle, Rohit extends his arms and hoists it over the bowler's head into the second tier of the Wankhede
flat and fired on off, dug out back to Tahir.
full on middle, shovel-driven to long-on
fuller on off, he saunters down the track and hits a drive to long-off
tossed up on off, driven in the air between point and extra-cover
Mishra held this one back on middle, check-pushed back to the bowler
flatter on middle and leg, nudged through midwicket
looped up, very full on off, jammed back at the bowler
slid through outside off, chopped to the right of Zaheer at short third. He dives and fumbles a bit. The pair get two
fractionally short and outside off, Rohit leans back and cuts it to point
pushed through on middle, dropped in front of Iyer at short midwicket
full and outside off, driven to long-off
short and wide outside off, cracked to the off-side sweeper
on a length and outside off, straight ball, pushed to cover
back of a length and on middle, Rayudu hangs back and knocks it in front of midwicket for one. Rohit reciprocated well
back of a length and outside off extra lift, ignored cautiously
hurled in full and outside off, jabbed in front of point
pitched up and shaping away, he prods and misses. The ball does not carry to the keeper
The Harbhajan experiment fails! And is starts to rain.. Back of a length, Harbhajan wants to swipe it away, but can only drag it back on to the off stump via a thick inside edge
whacked! On a length and outside off, Harbhajan slaps it over the bowlers head after making some room
parcelled up and dispatched. Short and wide outside off, Rohit fetches it from there and mauls it over midwicket with a strong pull
full and just a shade outside off, Rohit aims to drive but is beaten
back of a length and outside off, carved over cover-point to sweeper
back of a length, blocked to leg off an inside edge
Parthiv picks out Mishra. Back of a length and outside off, slowy in pace. Parthiv attempts another flashy cut and miscues it to Mishra at the covers. Mishra hops up and takes it
back of a length and outside off, Pathiv throws his bat at it slashes it over backward point with an extravagant follow through
back of a length on middle, worked through midwicket
full and outside off, crunched hard to point. Agarwal dives to his right and makes a sharp save. He clutches his hand in pain
bouncer outside off, Rohit goes for a pull and top-edges it over long leg. The pace of Coulter-Nile helped Rohit there
good length on off, blocked back to the bowler
Coulter-Nile tests Parthiv with a short ball. He swivels and pulls it over backward square leg
fuller and on middle and leg, he closes his bat face and clips it to the left of mid-on
Parthiv shimmies down the track and whips it over midwicket. Iyer covers plenty of ground in the deep, sprints across to his right, puts in a slide and saves a run for DD
full and on middle and leg, whisked to mid-on
Parthiv takes a step forward and flicks this one behind the square leg umpire
back of a length and on off, nudged in front of the covers. Parthiv looks for a speedy single but. Has to retreat
on the fuller side and attacks the stumps, driven to mid-on
Rohit rides the bounce of this shortish ball outside off and glides it to deep third man
back of a length and on middle, cramped for room. Pushed towards mid-on

Mumbai reduced to 8 for 2. Banged in short and hurries on with extra bounce at 136ks, too quick for Pandya. He hunts for a pull but has to settle with a top edge. Tahir comes in from mid-on, calls for it (midwicket was also in the picture). Tahir holds on
back of a length and seams in, punchily defended to mid-on
back of a length and zips in on off, Dabbed in front of the covers. And Coulter-Nile has the propensity to generate extra lift...
pitched up and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to mid-off
good length moving away, defended from the crease
pitched up and outside off, he seeks to square-drive and slices it in front of the fielder
swinging away outside off on a length, ignored
length and curving away, dropped in front of the covers for a quick single. Mathews swoops down on the ball and dives but fails to throw the stumps down. A direct hit could have put Pandya in trouble
drags another one down leg. Zaheer then investigates the landing area
away-swinger wide outside off, left alone. Past the tram-line
back of a length and on the hips, picked away behind square leg. Fine leg can't prevent the four
Mighty full and swings in, stuck on the front pad in front of leg. This was going down leg, though

Zaheer strikes, Simmons has to depart for a duck. This was the inswinger from Zaheer, he controls it. Simmons' balance is shot as he falls over the flick and is smacked on the front pad in front of middle. It would have grazed leg, I reckon. The forefinger goes up
swinging down leg, Simmons does not meet with the glance. Wide
